blocking_issues.location: PT-BR opening, market sections, Brazil section and diagrams
blocking_issues.issue: The PT-BR edition repeatedly exposes avoidable English market/internal vocabulary instead of natural Brazilian Portuguese, including 'repricing', 'supply chain', 'valuations' and repeated raw 'payroll'. This directly conflicts with EDITORIAL-STYLE.md, which explicitly requires 'repricing' to become 'reprecificação', 'valuation' to be translated according to context, and English terms to be retained only when conventional and precision-enhancing with explanation on first occurrence. The result does not read as originally written in Brazilian Portuguese and therefore fails publication-readiness localization.

required_fixes: Rewrite the PT-BR edition as idiomatic Brazilian Portuguese, replacing avoidable anglicisms throughout rather than patching isolated occurrences. At minimum replace 'repricing' with 'reprecificação', 'supply chain' with 'cadeia de suprimentos' or a context-specific equivalent, and 'valuations' with 'avaliações/precificações' as appropriate; translate or explain 'payroll' on first occurrence and use a natural Portuguese reference thereafter.
Preserve all figures, dates, epistemic status, causal claims and conclusions while performing the localization correction; EN/PT-BR must remain semantically equivalent.
Return the same ID and slug with new source/pending blob SHAs.
evidence: BLS official September 2026 data confirm +29,000 nonfarm payroll employment and 4.2% unemployment; the September release was scheduled for and issued on 2 October 2026.
ISM official September 2026 manufacturing data confirm Manufacturing PMI 54.5 and Prices Index 77.9.
TSE official result confirms Flavio Bolsonaro 47.03% and Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva 45.16% of valid votes with a runoff on 25 October 2026.
EDITORIAL-STYLE.md explicitly maps repricing to reprecificacao and valuation to avaliacao/precificacao/valorizacao, and requires natural Brazilian Portuguese rather than literal financial English.
